name: Return of the Ring
summary: In Gnomeregan, a golden ring bears a maker’s mark that leads you to Ironforge.

sections.title: A Sludge-Coated Treasure
sections.body: You place a grime-caked bauble in Gnomeregan’s Sparklematic 5200. The machine strips away years of irradiated grime, revealing a polished Brilliant Gold Ring that still hums with arcane power. Inside the band, three initials, “TdK,” sit beside Ironforge’s hallmark seal.

sections.title: The Artisan of the Mystic Ward
sections.body: Talvash del Kissel, a gnome jeweler in Ironforge’s Mystic Ward, recognizes the ring as one of his standard designs from before Gnomeregan fell. He often fends off imaginary debt collectors while he works. Learning that Dark Iron infiltrators carried the ring unsettles him, and leaves questions about what stirred beneath the lost city.

faq.q: Who made the ring found in Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: The initials “TdK” belong to Talvash del Kissel, a gnome jeweler in Ironforge’s Mystic Ward. Before Gnomeregan fell, he ran a jewelry shop there and made several simple magical rings of this design.

faq.q: Where did the ring originally come from?
faq.answer: The ring came from deep within Gnomeregan, where it was found as a grime-encrusted bauble carried by hostile invaders such as the Dark Iron dwarves. The Sparklematic 5200 restored its golden sheen and maker’s marks.

faq.q: Why were Dark Iron dwarves carrying Talvash's ring?
aliases: why do dark irons have it
faq.answer: Talvash is unsure why Dark Iron infiltrators carried his old work. The ring may have come from his abandoned workshop or been taken from someone who failed to escape Gnomeregan’s invasion.

faq.q: Why does Talvash del Kissel think you are his landlord?
faq.answer: Talvash is high-strung and eccentric, and often behind on his Ironforge rent. When strangers approach his shop aggressively, he assumes bailiffs or landlords have come to collect his overdue debts.
Talvash insists to prospective customers that he does not make cursed items. His nervous denials tend to raise more questions than they settle.

faq.q: Can I just keep the ring instead of returning it?
faq.answer: The ring has magical properties, but its creator can inspect it and offer to refine its enchantment through further work.

angles.text: As a gnome, finding lost handiwork in Gnomeregan offers a rare glimpse of the peaceful crafts your people practiced before Thermaplugg’s disaster.
As an Alliance member, you can see the growing threat Emperor Thaurissan’s agents pose to the Alliance’s mountain home in Ironforge-marked artifacts held by Dark Iron dwarves.
